channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy sites, including a strike that killed 17 people in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. President Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia that he framed as an energy ceasefire, but Ukraine called the claim false after further strikes. Russia arrested a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024.
